subject: maths

concepts.title: Square Numbers
concepts.definition: A natural number is considered a square number if it can be represented as the product of another natural number multiplied by itself.
concepts.key_idea: A perfect square is the result of squaring an integer.
question_patterns: is the number ... a square number
identify if ... is a perfect square
find the square of the number ...
check if ... can be expressed as a square

solution_steps.explain: the square of n is n times n

concepts.title: Square Root via Prime Factorization
concepts.definition: The square root of a number is the value which, when multiplied by itself, produces the original number.
concepts.key_idea: Pairing identical prime factors to determine the root.
question_patterns: find the square root of ... using prime factorization
what is the square root of ...
determine the root of ... by factoring

solution_steps.explain: calculate the root of the perfect square n

concepts.title: Pythagorean Triplets
concepts.definition: A set of three natural numbers (2m, m^2-1, m^2+1) that satisfy the relationship where the sum of the squares of the two smaller numbers equals the square of the largest.
concepts.key_idea: Sets of numbers forming sides of a right triangle.
question_patterns: find a pythagorean triplet with one member ...
write a pythagorean triplet where the smallest member is ...
calculate the pythagorean triplet for m = ...
determine the members of a triplet with one value ...

solution_steps.explain: check if the sum of squares of two members equals the square of the third

worked_examples.question_pattern: find a pythagorean triplet with smallest member {m}

questions: what will be the unit digit of the squares of 81?
are the following numbers perfect squares: 1057, 23453?
write a pythagorean triplet whose one member is 6.
